objective_id.format: normalized canonical form should be objective-<number> for exported packets; internal normalization may strip prefix for comparison only
objective_id.comparison_rule: normalize before comparison; preserve original exported text when writing packet payloads

task_id.comparison_rule: exact string match for runtime packets; no task-level fuzzy matching

request_id.format: defaults to task_id for bridge runtime packets unless an explicitly distinct request id exists
request_id.comparison_rule: exact string match for runtime packets and dedup memory

correlation_id.format: opaque string; defaults to request_id when no explicit correlation exists
correlation_id.comparison_rule: exact string match for runtime packets

sequence.comparison_rule: preferred freshness key over ordinal suffix

ordinal.format: numeric suffix derived from request_id or task_id only when sequence is unavailable

mirrors_and_diagnostics: MIM_TOD_* mirrored artifacts outside the live writer

rules: Only the live listener may publish strict runtime ACK and RESULT packets to the shared surface during normal operation.
listener_state and loop journal are authoritative state inputs, not mere telemetry.
This writer may replace drifted shared runtime latest artifacts when a canonical objective/task lane is explicitly provided.
Superseded shared-runtime payloads must be archived before replacement.
Shared truth is a reconciled view and must not be treated as the originating writer of ACK, RESULT, COMMAND_STATUS, or DECISION packets.
The writer may use limited objective-level precedence rules from authoritative MIM sources.
Replay mutation is opt-in and must require an explicit operator action.
Replay writes are exceptional and must archive prior live artifacts.
Mirror writers may copy artifacts into alternate roots but must not claim authorship or authority over the payload lineage they mirror.
Packet acceptance must be exact-match, not objective-only.
Packets must carry contract envelope fields, transport/source identity, and checksum-bound contract metadata.
If validation fails, the packet must not be published as accepted runtime truth.
Command status may mirror live runtime state, stale-guard state, and decision state, but it must not override ACK or RESULT contract validation outcomes.
If a validation failure occurs, status should reflect contract_violation_rejected and reference the violation payload.
Shared truth may reconcile across multiple surfaces and may apply timestamp-based precedence.
Objective-only precedence is allowed only under explicit authority-source rules.
Shared truth must expose the authority source and whether the selected view is authoritative.
Sequence must outrank ordinal suffix when present.
High-watermark comparison must be scoped to objective.
Loop-journal entries and listener-state watermark may both contribute to the effective watermark.
A stale-guard winner must record source, source_field, request_id, ordinal, and sequence.
Success publication must clear stale-guard carry-forward when the active lane has been corrected.

normal_replay: Replay should use bounded scoped replay state rather than invent a new authority source.
Replay should preserve canonical request identity when the operational goal is to re-run the same canonical lane.
forced_replay: Forced replay must require explicit operator intent.
Forced replay must verify that the current live request lane matches the requested target before mutation.
Forced replay must archive the prior live artifacts before overwriting latest files.

scoped_reset: A lineage reset must clear objective-scoped dedup and stale-guard memory in listener_state.
A lineage reset must remove or supersede conflicting loop-journal entries that outrank the canonical lane.
A lineage reset must not globally erase unrelated objective history.
post_reset_validation: ACK outer identity must match canonical task lane.
RESULT outer identity must match canonical task lane.
Embedded validator identity must match canonical task lane.
bridge_runtime.current_processing.task_id must match canonical task lane.
Command status must not remain in contract_violation_rejected for the repaired lane.

canonical_shared_runtime: Replacing canonical shared-runtime latest artifacts must archive the previous payload into a superseded store.
live_runtime_packets: Normal listener writes may overwrite latest ACK/RESULT/STATUS in place because these represent the live lane.
If persistent audit is required, the database layer should store every publish event as immutable rows while the file layer remains latest-only.
replay_mutations: Replay mutation of live latest files must archive the old live artifacts before replacement.

conditions: authority_source is formal_program_truth, task_status_review, or decision_task
MIM view is fresher or same-objective precedence conditions are met
objective_authority_eligible gates use of live task request task_id
canonical objective remains fixed but canonical task changes

forbidden.reason: Bridge runtime packets require exact identity match.
Current-processing task and correlation are part of strict runtime identity.

contract_failure_flow: resolved after a later valid packet for the same channel

readers_and_consumers.consumer_rule: Readers may summarize or compare payloads, but only the designated owners may publish authoritative replacements for a given artifact family.

principles: Store immutable publish events for runtime packets even if the file system stays latest-only.
Separate mutable listener memory from immutable runtime packets.
Represent shared truth as a derived materialized view or derived table, not as the origin of runtime packet rows.
Preserve supersession links for recoupled and replay-mutated artifacts.

rules: Exported packet field names must remain backward-compatible where current readers already expect them.
Normalization may be used for comparison, but the exported payload should preserve the established field names and packet shapes.
New fields should be additive and optional unless every active reader is upgraded in lockstep.
Legacy readers that inspect only objective_id or task_id should continue to receive those fields even when richer identity metadata is added.

implementation_guidance: Do not treat mirror copies under context-sync as original authority sources.
Do not reuse shared-truth objective-level precedence rules for ACK or RESULT packet acceptance.
When repairing lineage, clear stale carry-forward state and revalidate both outer and embedded identities.
If database-backed authority is introduced, file latest outputs should be projections of immutable rows plus explicit mutable listener-memory state.
